label: rem:hoefsmit-ew-cell-content-context
title: Electroweak naming, minimality, interface-knot refinement, and further structure of the Hoefsmit electroweak cell content
html:
Naming: the electroweak carriers

The three carrier powers of the Hoefsmit cell content are named after the electroweak force-carriers:

  W \;\longleftrightarrow\; \sigma_1^{\,4} \;\;(\text{strands 1--2}),
  \quad
  Z \;\longleftrightarrow\; \sigma_3^{\,6} \;\;(\text{strands 3--4}),
  \quad
  H \;\longleftrightarrow\; \sigma_5^{\,8} \;\;(\text{strands 5--6}),

and the six patterns other than (s,s,s) and (a,a,a) are named by the carriers whose idempotent is antisymmetric: (a,s,s), (s,a,s) and (s,s,a) are the W, Z and H patterns, and (a,a,s), (a,s,a) and (s,a,a) are the WZ, WH and ZH patterns. These labels carry no charge assignment. On its own strand pair the carrier \sigma^{2k}, k = 2, 3, 4, closes to a two-component link of writhe 2k, and in the standard braid presentation of torus links that closure is the torus link T(2, 2k); so the carriers are read as T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8) on Bring's surface. This is a naming of constructions. That these links are the physical W^\pm, Z and H is the electroweak/Higgs torus-link identification. It is not used by the theorem.

Minimality of n = 6

Each EW carrier acts on a single strand-pair. Three carriers need three disjoint strand-pairs. For n < 6, carriers share strand-pairs, their generators no longer commute, and the simultaneous-eigenspace decomposition degenerates.

Refinement: coupling via interface knot

The disjoint-product framing treats W, Z, H as independent. The corrected EW braid uses an interface knot \bowtie_K \in H_6(q) to mediate the coupling, analogous to the inter-nucleon interface in the deuteron derivation. The corrected braid is:

  \beta_{\rm EW}(\bowtie_K)
  \;:=\;
  \sigma_1^{\,4} \cdot \bowtie_K^{(W \to Z)} \cdot \sigma_3^{\,6}
  \cdot \bowtie_K^{(Z \to H)} \cdot \sigma_5^{\,8} \cdot \bowtie_K^{(H \to W)}.

This modifies pattern multiplicities, impacts bar-self-duality, gives the Higgs-vev automorphism a concrete form, and twists the 8 pure patterns.

Resolution of the dimension-collapse issue

On the 20 standard tableaux of size 6 on which \sigma_1, \sigma_3, \sigma_5 all act diagonally, the six EW patterns W, Z, H, WZ, WH, ZH occur with tableau multiplicities 2, 1, 3, 3, 1, 2, and the two non-EW patterns, the vacuum (s,s,s) and the fully broken (a,a,a), with multiplicity 4 each. These are counts of tableaux, not ranks. The six EW patterns sit alongside the two non-EW patterns, resolving the dimension-collapse issue of the H_2(q)-only completeness sum.

The Plancherel weight is a degenerate special case

The earlier Plancherel-weighted multiplier framing is incorrect. The structural multiplier is the direct unweighted trace \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure} over the pure seminormal vectors, which preserves bar-self-duality automatically from the disjoint-strand-pair construction.

Implication for N_v derivation

The constrained-PSLQ basis for N_v must use the direct cell-content trace \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure} as the structural input, demoting the Plancherel framing to a degenerate special case.

Historical alignment: quaternionic electroweak theory

The disjoint-strand-pair identification parallels Morita's quaternionic formulation of the Weinberg–Salam theory [morita1982]. The QOU tetraplectic boundary supplies a geometric home for the \mathrm{SU}(2) structures. The unit-quaternion actions are norm-preserving and commute; identifying these algebraic actions with physical carriers is an interpretive alignment, not a derivation.
